description:
lib/list.fz defines neither. List.first([5, 6]) fails with error[resolve/unknown-import]: module List does not export first/1 (reported by session Type System, confirmed by reading lib/list.fz at develop cbe0630a4: it exports only concat, member?, reduce, reduce_while, reverse, subtract). Elixir: List.first([]) is nil, List.first([], d) is d, same for last. Sibling of fz-sc8.132 (List.foldl/foldr). The rest of the List module (flatten, delete, zip, duplicate, wrap, keyfind, ...) is also absent; not in the distiller's path. Signal: an oracle fixture on interp, run and build.

Scope extended (Elixir Parity, 2026-11-23): also sweep List's exports against Elixir's List module and add what is missing, or name each gap. Owner: Elixir Parity.
title: List.first/1,2 and List.last/1,2
